build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates standing sticks with a hovering ball and obstacles
add_static_bar: create a static bar object in the PHYRE scene with configurable scale and position
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball object to the PHYRE scene at a specified position
update_task_goal: define the PHYRE task goal by setting body relationships like TOUCHING between objects
get_phantom_vertices: extract phantom vertices from dynamic standingsticks to track their state in the task
